reviews.title: Mind of its own
reviews.text:
While making a map to ride is ok my issue is that when I went on the ride it did not follow the route which I created.  Also along the route unwanted directions and loops appeared along the route. While I could skip them it sometimes was difficult to determine what was part of the actual route and what was just made up.  
I was also surprised to see that settings from the Mac version did not present themselves on the iPhone when riding.  Why are their separate settings for each?

reviews.title: Guess I'm too dumb
reviews.text: Could not, no matter what I did, or where I serached for an answer on the web, figure out how to get it to stop placing my starting point in Redwood, City. I'm trying to flee the obtusely impossible UI of Google Maps, not sink deeper into the swamp. Thanks but no thanks.

reviews.title: Better options for free
reviews.text: I’m not going to pay the expensive monthly/annual fees for this when I can get the same thing for free from other apps, it’s got nice features but not worth it

reviews.title: Need work for motorcycles
reviews.text: It tried to send me grown roads that have been under construction for a year, and the option to avoid highways and take curvy roads keep taking me on loops. I was heading into the mountain. And only the 2 lane highway I was in went up there.  It kept takin me On loops that were 3-4 miles long and then putting me back on the highway 2 miles down from where I got off of it.  Figured out how to disable 2nd and 3rd voice warnings, but when I decided to stop taking the detour loops, it tried every road for the next 20 miles, with four warnings per try.  “Turn here in half a mile.  Now 1/4 mile.  Now 100 yard.  Now 50 feet. “.  Over and over and over.  Oh and despite being disabled, it will give a shrill sing for “recalculating” every time I refused a detour.

reviews.title: Nope
reviews.text: Unintuitive. Google Maps is better lol

reviews.title: Not accurate routing
reviews.text: Routing in bosnia and herzegovina is terrible. Unusable most of the time.

reviews.title: Failed first attempt
reviews.text: Bought in off of reviews.   Gave it a destination and it couldn’t turn out a scenic ride.

reviews.title: Horrible Horrible
reviews.text: This is about the most unfriendly user app I have ever used.  Even synthetic intelligence couldn't figure out how to use it.  SAVE YOUR MONEY!!

reviews.title: New
reviews.text: It’s a bit tricky learning how to use the app.  Am I missing the tutorial

reviews.title: Difficult to import GPX
reviews.text: Every time I want to import a GPX file I have to go through a several step process. Very painful.

reviews.title: Slow!
reviews.text: This app is beyond slow. Have to tell it twenty times to save a route. Even if you create a copy of someone else’s route you have to tell it to create a copy multiple times to finally get it to copy. Then when you follow someone else’s route you have no clue what kind of roads you’re about to hit. Should make people leave a brief description of the roads. Avoid getting down into township roads that are muddy 🤬. Def not paying for this app any more!!

reviews.title: Horribly complicated app
reviews.text: Never ever I’ve been exposed to such a complicated navigation app. Canceling two hours after subscribing.

reviews.title: New rider opinion
reviews.text: Every single ride I’ve tried to create has tried to put me on i405. Nope. No means to change the settings to allow me to avoid highways or freeways. Until then, removing this app.

reviews.title: Crashes more times then Helen Keller on a bicycle
reviews.text: Every time I use the search function for a location it crashes while generating a route. For an app you pay for this is unacceptable.

reviews.title: Hot Garbage
reviews.text: If I could give this app negative star’s I would, the only thing that’s good about it is the route it found, the rest is a disaster. Loading the GPX file was a pain (and having to load it again when the app quit for some unknown reason was no picnic either), the interface was annoying to use I couldn’t figure out how to put it in turn by turn mode it just stayed in map overview mode, someone on the ride found the turn by turn that was fine but it consumed a lot of battery life and the battery saver mode is so basic that it causes some confusion, and everyone’s map on the ride was a little different so some people took different turns, this app makes you wish that Google would just build a choice for the scenic route in to Google Maps, oh and lastly this goes out to all Nav apps not jus this one, the turn by turn “voice” part should be off by default and there should be a button on the screen prominently featured to turn the goddam voice off!!!!

reviews.title: Wanted to ride, got frustrated instead
reviews.text:
Got the app because I can't custom adjust a scenic direction path on Apple maps, got the app and bought premium subscription.

Could not even use it one time. Kept trying to "add to route" different locations near my target and each one would cause the app to shut down.

Not wasting more time, cancelled premium, deleting app. Please fix this extremely obnoxious issue for existing users and potential users just trying to ride that day.

reviews.title: I used to love this app
reviews.text: I loved this app when it first was released and bought a good amount of maps. Now I can’t even plan a simple trip and am totally perplexed of how to get from one point to another. I’ve cancelled my subscription.

reviews.title: Can’t even load a GPX right
reviews.text:
I was looking for an app to navigate me around a GPX route. The app offers two ways to import a GPX. Tried both. Neither followed the route. It cut out all the interesting parts of the route by moving it from green lanes to normal roads. Plus the price is ridiculous for an app I want to use one a month.

Not the app for me

reviews.title: You Will Get Junk Email
reviews.text: The Scenic App will either sell or give away you email address and you will get junk email from companies like “TTAC / the truth about cancer”, which is nothing even related to the APP.

reviews.title: Not user friendly
reviews.text: There are no decent tutorials. The last tutorial I found was about three iterations ago and there’s been significant changes. I’m sure once you get the hang of it. It’s probably a good program. But getting the hang of it is a beat down.
